description: File a bug report or feedback to the maintainers. Pass a short message (and optional structured context like versions/ids). Returns a reference id. It sends no payment details and cannot change any order — it just files the report. Tokens/emails are redacted server-side.

context.description: optional structured context (versions, ids) — tokens/emails are redacted server-side

message.description: what went wrong / the feedback (one or two sentences)

name: report_issue
